text: Readings, photos and findings flow into a draft for review and approval.
See field entries become a report draft for the office.
Previous readings are shown for comparison alongside the new entry fields.
The same values appear in the draft, without retyping them in the office.
The reviewer can see which finding the photo documents.
The office checks the draft and resolves missing details before approval.
Office amendments retain a reason and the previous values.
The technician receives the note inside the same inspection.
The office sees the updated entries and continues the review.
Report approval does not close the deficiency. Its status stays visible.
Open an earlier report to see what was inspected and what has changed.
Send a form and sample report. Within 3 business days; complex forms get an agreed delivery date.
